title: Shingo Takagi carries the world title
summary: An unexpected vacancy gives Shingo Takagi another chance to reach New Japan’s summit. Okada stands at both ends of the Dragon’s first world championship reign.

chapters.title: Shingo wins the vacant championship
chapters.result: Shingo defeats Okada for the vacant world title.
chapters.context: Ospreay’s absence opens the championship match, and Shingo converts the opportunity into his first reign.

chapters.title: Okada takes the title in the Dome
chapters.result: Okada defeats Shingo for the world championship.
chapters.context: The rematch ends Shingo’s reign at New Japan’s biggest annual stage.
